findings.problem: The trick says cámara is camera with an extra a, but the two words have the same number of letters: the e in camera becomes an a, so the spelling claim is false.
findings.fix: trick: CÁMARA is camera with the e swapped for an a: say cheese, the cámara is rolling.

back.es: the camera (also: chamber, as in a legislative chamber)

note: In Mexico, ¡cámara! is also common slang for 'okay / deal', which the editor might mention somewhere else, but camera is the right core meaning for this card.
